hero.lead: A traiteur in Brussels for private hosts and companies. Seasonal plates, cooked each morning and delivered ready to serve.

intro.headline: A traiteur in Brussels for people who care how it tastes — and how it looks.
intro.body: We cook for private hosts and companies across the city. Seasonal plates, salads and cold-pressed juices, prepared each morning and delivered ready to serve. We run events end to end, and keep a coffee desk open for anyone passing by.

kitchen.label: The kitchen
kitchen.title: Cooked the morning it is eaten.
kitchen.body: We start before dawn, when the city is still quiet. Plates, salads and cold-pressed juices are made from scratch that same morning — seasonal produce, sauces reduced overnight, dressings mixed at the last minute. Nothing reheated, nothing left over from the day before.

delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.title: Prepared at dawn, served by lunch.
delivery.body: We pack and send across Brussels in the early hours, so lunch arrives as the kitchen intended. Insulated boxes, portions already set, garnishes kept separate — ready to unwrap and serve at your desk, in a meeting room, or at home before your guests walk in.

items.title: Delivery
items.body: Plates, salads and juices prepared each morning and delivered ready to serve — to a desk, a boardroom or a kitchen table.

items.title: Events
items.body: From a twenty-person launch to a seated dinner. We handle the menu, the service and everything that has to happen before the doors open.

items.title: Coffee
items.body: A coffee desk for anyone passing by, and the same pastries and juices we send out to our clients.

whyUs.label: Why choose us
whyUs.headline: Good food is the easy part. This is the rest of it.

reasons.title: One number to call
reasons.body: The person who answers writes the menu, and is still the person answering the week of the delivery. Nothing is subcontracted, so nothing is lost between two companies.

reasons.title: Quoted per head, all in
reasons.body: Delivery, service, equipment and collection are in the figure we send you. No line items appearing three days before the event.

reasons.title: Diets planned, not patched
reasons.body: Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free versions of the same dish, labelled and boxed separately. Nobody is handed a plate of side dishes.

reasons.title: A window we keep
reasons.body: Brussels traffic is a known quantity, so we leave early and we call before you have to. If something moves, you hear it at six in the morning, not at noon.

calendar.label: Book for delivery
calendar.note: Pick any open day to add it to your order — you do not need anything in your basket yet. We need {days} days' notice and we do not deliver on Sundays.
calendar.savedSuffix: . It travels with your order — change it any time before checkout.
